Vacancy for Medical Officer
Wednesday, 04 March 2020
5655 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data with necessary experience
certificates/testimonials for the post of Medical Officer (Ayush) for KRHTC, Anji center under the Department of Community Medicine. The application must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by
31/03/2020
.
Required Qualification & Experience: BAMS/BHMS. Candidates with previous experience of working in Hospital will be preferred.
Salary: As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age Limit: 38 years.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
